presets.label: L-eNhance
presets.intended_use: Dual-band H-alpha 656nm (12nm) + OIII/H-beta 496-501nm (24nm) for emission nebulae with OSC cameras under moderate light pollution

presets.label: L-eXtreme
presets.intended_use: Dual-band H-alpha 656nm + OIII 501nm (7nm each) for emission nebulae with OSC cameras under heavy light pollution

presets.label: L-Pro
presets.intended_use: Broadband light-pollution suppression (380-750nm) for natural star colors with OSC/DSLR cameras; galaxies, reflection nebulae, star clusters
